question: A shopkeeper bought a chair for ₹750. He sold it at a 10% loss. What was the selling price of the chair?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Loss % = 10% ⇒ Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) − Loss.

Loss = (10/100) × 750 = ₹75.

SP = CP − Loss = 750 − 75 = ₹675.

**∴ Answer = ₹675**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹750, Loss % = 10%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP − (Loss % × CP).

 Cost Price (₹750) Loss (₹75) SP 675) 
• 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Loss = (10/100) × 750 = ₹75.

⇒ SP = 750 − 75 = ₹675.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹675.**
